theater: 昇龍都與平厲原、洮江沿岸

battle.name: 蒙古攻安南之戰
battle.theater: 昇龍都與平厲原、洮江沿岸
battle.brief: 元憲宗七年（1257）冬，都元帥兀良哈台自雲南率兵三萬南下，十二月十二日陷平厲原，陳軍步象騎混陣不敵，國都昇龍失守；元軍破城而居九日，因暑熱缺糧撤軍，十二月二十四日陳太宗乘樓船於東步頭反擊，弩箭自舟船齊發，迫其退歸化寨。

kit.name: 十字弩
kit.history: 弩把射速交給了機械，代價是裝填慢。城牆上它比長弓可靠，野戰裡它比長弓脆弱。

countries: 交戰的兩方是蒙古帝國與大越陳朝。蒙古方面，1257年時大汗為憲宗蒙哥，正率主力攻打四川，南方經略由忽必烈在燕京一線主持；前一年蒙古已平滅大理國，雲南歸附之後，兀良哈台以雲南為基地奉命經略交趾。蒙古軍自雲南出發，兵眾約三萬，含蒙古騎兵、漢軍步卒、雲南附庸土兵，並有熟悉南中國山川的舊宋人充任嚮導與攻城工匠。指揮上以兀良哈台為都元帥，其下遣徹徹都等各將千人分道進兵，抵安南京北洮江上，再派其子阿朮率兵為援，另先遣使二人往諭交趾。大越方面是陳朝，陳太宗陳煚以陳守度為太師掌政，兵權歸興道王陳國峻，國都昇龍設城防、宮禁與水軍，樞密院、侍中府並置，郡兵、屯田軍與鄉兵各有編制，歸化、浪潮等邊寨土司聽命於朝廷。陳朝同時受南宋與蒙古兩面壓力，兵力和糧秣分散在由雲南邊界到昇龍的縱深，很難在一處集中主力。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the Mongol Empire and the Trần dynasty of Đại Việt. On the Mongol side the Great Khan in 1257 was Möngke, then committing his main strength against Sichuan, while southern strategy was organised by Kublai from his base in the Yanjing region; the year before the Mongols had crushed the Dali kingdom, and with Yunnan pacified, Urryankhadai took Yunnan as his base and was charged with administering Jiaozhi. The Mongol army marched out of Yunnan with a force of roughly thirty thousand men, made up of Mongol cavalry, Han Chinese foot soldiers, Yunnanese auxiliaries, and former Song men who knew the mountains and rivers of southern China and served as guides and siege craftsmen. Command lay with Urryankhadai as chief commander; below him generals such as Chechedu were sent forward with a thousand men each along separate roads, and once the main body reached the Thao River north of the Annam capital his son Arju was sent to bring up reinforcements, while two envoys had already been despatched ahead to summon Jiaozhi to submit. On the Đại Việt side stood the Trần court: Emperor Thái Tông Trần Thánh governed through the Grand Preceptor Trần Thủ Độ and gave the army to the Prince of Hưng Đạo, Trần Quốc Tuấn; the capital at Thăng Long had walls, a palace quarter and a war fleet, the Privy Council and the Chancellery stood side by side, provincial garrison troops, landless soldiers settled on state farms and village levies each had their own establishment, and the stockade communities of Quy Hóa and Lãng Câu obeyed the court. Pressured from the Song and the Mongols at once, the Trần army and its supplies were spread along a depth running from the Yunnan frontier to Thăng Long, and it was very hard to concentrate the main body in one place.
people: 蒙古一方的主帥是都元帥兀良哈台，術赤之孫、博爾忽之子，早年從拔都西征，1257年冬自雲南率兵三萬入交趾。兵抵洮江即遣徹徹都等分道進攻，其子阿朮奉命率兵為援；先行派出的兩名使者被陳朝扣在獄中，消息傳回之後蒙古人出兵轉趨激烈。陳朝方面，國主陳太宗陳煚自率大軍至前線督戰，首戰失利後退保瀘江、天幕江，仍乘樓船問計於太尉欽天王陳日晈；陳日晈以手指水、在船舷寫下「入宋」二字勸他投奔南宋，太師陳守度則以「臣首未至地」作答，表示要死守到底。興道王陳國峻在九月奉命集結各路將帥，統轄從雲南邊界到昇龍的防務。侍中黎秦在太宗回望親信時自請出陣，單騎出入敵軍而神情自若，戰後受賜名「輔陳」、授御史大夫，並以昭聖公主（陳太宗前妻）嫁之。太子陳晃隨父出戰，十二月二十四日以樓船在東步頭取勝。邊地方面，歸化寨主何屈最早報知蒙古使者來臨，寨主何俸在元軍撤退途中集蠻兵襲擊，是元軍退出交趾的關鍵外力。翌年，陳朝遣黎輔陳與周博覽入蒙，議定每三年進貢一次的常例。
peopleEn: The Mongol commander was the chief commander Urryankhadai, a grandson of Jochi and a son of Bo'orchu, who had campaigned in the west under Batu; in the winter of 1257 he led some thirty thousand men out of Yunnan into Jiaozhi. As soon as his troops reached the Thao River he sent Chechedu and other generals forward along separate roads, and his son Arju was ordered to bring up support; the two envoys sent in advance were held in prison by the Trần court, and once that news came back the Mongols turned to open force. On the Đại Việt side Emperor Thái Tông Trần Thánh himself led the field army and directed the fighting, and after the first defeat fell back to the river lines at Lô and Thiên Mộ, still consulting his ministers from the deck of a tower ship. There the Grand Commander Trần Nhật Điểm, called the 太尉欽天王, traced characters on the side of the vessel with his finger and wrote 「入宋」, that is, go to the Song, advising the emperor to seek refuge with the Southern Song; the Grand Preceptor Trần Thủ Độ answered instead 「臣首未至地」, that his own head had not yet fallen to the ground, meaning that he would hold fast to the end. The Prince of Hưng Đạo, Trần Quốc Tuấn, was ordered in September to gather the commanders of all the armies and to direct the defence from the Yunnan frontier to Thăng Long. When the emperor looked over his trusted men after the defeat, only Lê Tâm offered to go out, riding alone in and out of the enemy ranks with an unbroken bearing; afterwards he was granted the title 輔陳, made Censor-in-Chief, and was given the former empress, Princess Thánh Thánh, in marriage. The crown prince Trần Hoảng fought beside his father, and on the twenty-fourth day of the twelfth month a victory was won at Đông Bước from the tower ships. On the frontier, Hà Khuất, chief of the Quy Hóa stockade, was the first to report the arrival of the Mongol envoys, and Hà Bổng, chief of another stockade, mustered local fighters against the withdrawing Mongols, an outside pressure that mattered greatly to the Mongol withdrawal. The year after the campaign the Trần court sent Lê Phụ Trần and Chu Bác Lãm to the Mongol court, where a fixed tribute of one delivery every three years was agreed.
kits: 本卡兵器是十字弩。歐洲十字弩自十一世紀以來定型，以拉弦上機、扣機發矢取代長弓的拉弦，優點是單兵可以反覆精確射擊，在城頭居高臨下之際足以壓制逼近的騎兵；弱點是裝填緩慢，野戰中一旦被騎兵貼近便難以再射。因此它在這場戰爭裡的位置很清楚：屬於固定陣地上的直射兵器，交戰兩方都把它當作守城與舟船上的骨幹，而不是決定野戰勝負的力量。蒙古軍以騎兵為主軸，弩手配置在隊伍側翼與攻城序列中，主要用途是在渡江與攻城的混亂中向城頭射擊、壓制守軍，並非用來在開闊地上和陳軍對射；蒙古人自雲南南下的真正優勢在速度與衝鋒，不在弩。陳朝這邊恰好相反，步象騎混編的陣線以弩手與持盾步兵在前，戰象居中衝撞，騎兵在兩翼待機，弩的齊射用來在騎兵接觸之前削弱對方。昇龍城頭、各處柵寨與江上舟船同樣配置弩手，陳軍在樓船上還要應對沿兩岸逼近的蒙古騎兵。攻城與野戰的其餘裝備包括弓、矛、盾、象，以及水陸並行所用的舟船；元軍靠雲南的糧源與河道船運維持，卻在炎熱潮濕的紅河三角洲找不到足夠的馬匹飼料與糧食，佔領都城九日之後只能因缺糧與暑熱退兵。關於雙方弩的數量與編制，兩國史冊都沒有留下明細，只能從兵種結構推測。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is the crossbow. The European crossbow had been fixed in its form since the eleventh century, replacing the drawn string of the longbow with a mechanism cocked by a winch and released by a trigger; its advantage is that a single man can shoot accurately and repeatedly, and from a wall it is enough to hold off cavalry that is closing in, while its weakness is the slow reload, which leaves a crossbowman helpless if cavalry reaches him in open ground. Its place in this war is therefore clear: it is a direct-fire weapon of fixed positions, and both sides used it as the backbone of garrison and boat crews rather than as the thing that decided a field battle. The Mongol army was built around cavalry; its crossbowmen sat on the flanks of the column and in the assault echelon, used mainly to shoot at the walls during river crossings and sieges and to pin the defenders, not to trade volleys with the Trần army in the open. The real Mongol advantage on the march out of Yunnan was speed and the charge, not the crossbow. The Trần side was the opposite: the mixed line of foot, elephants and cavalry put crossbowmen and shield-bearing infantry in front, elephants charging in the middle and cavalry waiting on the flanks, so that a volley of bolts weakened the enemy before the horsemen closed. Crossbowmen were likewise posted on the walls of Thăng Long, at the stockade redoubts and in the boats on the river, and the Trần had to meet Mongol horsemen riding along the banks while they stood their tower ships. The rest of the equipment used in the assault and in the field included bows, spears, shields, elephants, and the vessels that let both sides move on water and land together. The Yuan drew its grain from Yunnan and moved it by river boat, but in the hot, wet Red River delta it could find neither enough fodder for its horses nor enough food for its men, and after nine days in the captured capital it had to withdraw for want of supplies and because of the heat. Neither the Yuan nor the Trần chronicles preserve any detail on how many crossbows each side fielded or how they were organised; that can only be inferred from the structure of the armies.
tactics: 蒙古軍的戰術核心是分道與速進。兀良哈台先遣使二人往諭，不見回報即改用武力；主力抵洮江後，徹徹都等各將千人分道進兵，避開陳軍設於山口的抵抗，循邊寨之間的通路直插平厲原，再壓向昇龍。蒙古騎兵在開闊的三角洲上以速度換取衝鋒的壓力，攻城時靠人數與突進的強度硬壓；佔領國都之後原打算以既得的城池作據點，卻發現城內空虛、糧食已被陳廷轉移，暑熱與缺糧在九日內逼退他們，撤退時隊伍沿邊境回雲南，沿途遭地方寨兵與蠻兵四面襲擊，退到歸化寨再受重創，損失在撤離之前就已累積到無法追擊的程度。陳軍的戰術則是縱深抵抗與逐次反攻：先以步象騎混編陣迎戰，首輪崩潰後退守瀘江與天幕江兩道江防，把都城與糧源護在身後；國都被攻破期間，太宗以樓船載朝廷沿江而退，與左右重臣議事而不散帳；待元軍退意已萌，十二月二十四日以樓船在東步頭出擊，弩箭與弓矢自舟船及兩岸齊發，蒙古騎兵失去衝鋒的展開空間，士氣與補給同時崩解，終於全軍退向雲南。弩在此役的真正功用，是讓沒有騎兵的守方仍能製造殺傷，使蒙古軍每次接近城垣與舟船都要付出可觀代價。關於各處戰場的具體陣形與部署，現存史料只留下片段記載。
tacticsEn: The core of the Mongol method was separation and speed. Urryankhadai sent two envoys ahead to summon submission, and when no answer came he switched to force; once the main body reached the Thao River, Chechedu and the other generals moved with a thousand men each along separate roads, slipped past the Trần blocking positions in the passes, pushed through the gaps between the frontier stockades straight onto Bình Lệ Nguyên, and then bore down on Thăng Long. Mongol cavalry exchanged speed for the pressure of the charge on the open delta, and at the walls they simply crowded forward with numbers and the weight of the assault. Having taken the capital they intended to use the city as a base, and found it empty, with the grain already carried off by the Trần court; heat and hunger drove them out within nine days. On the way back the column hugged the frontier on its road to Yunnan and was attacked from several sides by local stockade troops and hill fighters, and at Quy Hóa it was mauled again, so that the losses had already grown past the point where pursuit could be contemplated. The Trần method was resistance in depth and a counterstroke in stages: they first met the assault with the mixed line of foot, elephants and cavalry, and after that line broke they held the two river lines at Lô and Thiên Mộ, keeping the capital and the food supply behind them; while the city was being taken the emperor carried the court down the river on a tower ship, taking counsel with his ministers without dispersing his tent; and once the Mongols showed signs of wanting to leave, on the twenty-fourth day of the twelfth month he struck from the tower ships at Đông Bước, with bolts and arrows flying from the vessels and from both banks, so that the Mongol horse had no room to open up its charge and their morale and supply broke at the same time, and the whole army turned back towards Yunnan. The true function of the crossbow in this campaign was to let a side without cavalry still inflict damage, making every approach of the Mongols to the walls and to the boats cost them a price. For the actual formations and deployments on each battlefield, the surviving records give only fragments.
data: 可核對的數字有限，但仍有幾項可用。蒙古軍的總兵力，《大越史記全書》與《元史·外夷傳·安南》均記為約三萬；《元史》另記分道進兵時徹徹都等將領各領千人，這是唯一具體到分隊規模的記載。作戰時間軸可由陰曆月日與《大越史記全書》的記日對照整理：1257年八月，歸化寨主何屈報知蒙古遣使；九月，陳太宗下戰令，命左右將帥水陸並進、日夜兼程往邊界集結，由興道王陳國峻統領；十一月，蒙古使者仍被扣於陳朝獄中，《元史》記作「兵次交趾北」；十二月十二日，兀良哈台部陷平厲原，陳軍首次接戰即敗，國都昇龍失守；元軍在都城停留九日，十二月二十四日，陳太宗與太子陳晃乘樓船於東步頭擊敗蒙古軍，隨後元軍退至歸化寨再遭襲擊，終於撤出交趾。越曆十二月大約落在西曆1257年底至1258年初，故此役常被記作1257至1258年之役。作戰之後的結果寫在制度上：1258年，陳朝遣黎輔陳、周博覽入蒙，議定每三年向蒙古進貢一次並定為常例。以後兩次入侵的規模被記為約五十萬與約三十萬，第一次的三萬人是三次中最少的一次。距離也構成一項限制：雲南基地至昇龍的進軍線要穿越邊寨與紅河三角洲，蒙古軍九日的駐留時間遠不足以消化這段補給線的長度。
dataEn: Only a limited number of figures can be checked, but several are usable. The total strength of the Mongol force is given as about thirty thousand men by both the Đại Việt sử ký toàn thư and the Yuan History chapter on the foreign peoples; the Yuan History also records that when the advance was split into separate columns the generals such as Chechedu each led a thousand men, and that is the only record giving a figure down to the size of a detachment. The timeline can be reconstructed by matching the lunar dates against the day-by-day entries of the Đại Việt sử ký toàn thư: in the eighth month of 1257 Hà Khuất, chief of the Quy Hóa stockade, reported that the Mongols had sent envoys; in the ninth month the emperor Thái Tông issued the order of war, telling the commanders on his left and right to move by land and water together and assemble at the border day and night under the Prince of Hưng Đạo Trần Quốc Tuấn; in the eleventh month the Mongol envoys were still held in the Trần prisons, the Yuan History recording that the army reached Jiaozhi to the north; on the twelfth day of the twelfth month the corps of Urryankhadai took Bình Lệ Nguyên, the Trần army was defeated at the first contact, and the capital of Thăng Long was lost; the Yuan stayed nine days in the capital, and on the twenty-fourth day of the twelfth month Thái Tông and the crown prince Trần Hoảng beat the Mongols at Đông Bước from their tower ships, after which the Yuan withdrew to Quy Hóa, was attacked again, and finally left Đại Việt. The Vietnamese twelfth lunar month of that year falls roughly between the end of 1257 and the beginning of 1258 in the Gregorian calendar, which is why the campaign is usually dated 1257 to 1258. The result after the fighting was written into institutions: in 1258 the Trần court sent Lê Phụ Trần and Chu Bác Lãm to the Mongols, and a tribute of one delivery every three years was agreed and made a standing rule. The later two invasions are recorded with forces of about five hundred thousand and about three hundred thousand, so the thirty thousand men of the first were the smallest of the three. Distance was itself a constraint: the march from the Yunnan base to Thăng Long had to cross the frontier stockades and the Red River delta, and nine days of occupation was far too short to digest a supply line of that length.
cause: 打起來有遠因，也有近因。遠因是蒙古在亞洲大陸的擴張次序：1230年代滅西夏、1234年滅金，1254年又平了大理國，雲南到手之後，南面的安南在蒙古人的地圖上便成了南宋背後的一枚釘子——若能控制交趾，蒙古就有可能從西南迂迴包抄兩淮與荊襄，不必再啃襄樊一線的硬城。忽必烈在燕京一線主持南方經略時，方向正是雲南、交趾、南宋三點連成一線。近因出在交趾本身的應對上：蒙古先遣使二人往諭交趾，勸其歸附；陳朝沒有迎接使者，反而把來使扣在獄中，此事經《元史》記為「不返」，便成了蒙古用兵的直接口實。國內，陳太宗即位後由太師陳守度主持朝政，兵權交與興道王陳國峻，陳國峻在蒙古使團到來之前已整備軍令、沿邊布置寨防，歸化寨主何屈八月的報告更證實來使不是虛驚。兩面受敵的現實壓力也在推著陳朝走：陳朝與南宋之間長期有藩屬式的往來，一旦蒙古滅宋，安南將獨自無援；反過來，若陳朝拒絕蒙古的招撫，就必須自己承擔後果。於是外交上的沉默，最終演成了邊境上的刀兵。
causeEn: There were remote causes and immediate ones. The remote cause was the order of Mongol expansion across Asia: the Xixia destroyed in the 1230s, the Jin in 1234, and in 1254 the Dali kingdom was levelled. With Yunnan in hand, Đại Việt became, on the Mongol map, a nail in the back of the Southern Song; if Jiaozhi could be controlled, the Mongols might turn the southern flank and close around Liangzhu and Jingxiang without having to break the hard cities on the Xiangfan line. When Kublai organised southern strategy from the Yanjing area, the line of direction was exactly Yunnan, Jiaozhi and the Song joined together. The immediate cause lay in Đại Việt's own response: the Mongols sent two envoys ahead to summon Jiaozhi to submit; the Trần court did not receive them but imprisoned them instead, and the Yuan History records the matter as 「不返」, their failure to return, which became the stated occasion for the war. At home, since Thái Tông took the throne the Grand Preceptor Trần Thủ Độ had directed the government and the army had been given to the Prince of Hưng Đạo, Trần Quốc Tuấn, who had already set the armies in order and posted the stockades along the frontier before the Mongol mission arrived; the report of the Quy Hóa chief in the eighth month confirmed that the envoys were no empty rumour. The reality of being pressed from two sides also pushed the Trần court along: relations with the Southern Song had long been of a vassal kind, and once the Mongols destroyed the Song, Đại Việt would be left without support; conversely, if the Trần refused the Mongol summons, they would have to bear the consequences themselves. So the silence of diplomacy turned at last into the swords on the frontier.
impact: 這場戰役的直接影響不只在戰場上。元軍攻入昇龍而未能生擒陳廷，等於宣告「速勝安南」的路線失敗，蒙古在南方的戰略重心仍舊只能放在攻宋之上，越南這一段只被當成側翼與牽制。對陳朝而言，勝仗的意義遠大於失城：陳太宗以樓船出擊、在亂軍中收復國都的消息傳開之後，黎秦獲賜名「輔陳」並升任御史大夫、又娶昭聖公主，寨主何俸受封侯爵，越南社會從此把這場仗視為王朝的立國之戰，黎秦單騎出入敵陣的形象被寫進正史，陳朝在後世史家的敘述裡也由此確立「三拒元軍」的英雄譜系。制度上的後果更為持久：陳朝在打退元軍之後同時向兩邊交代，向南宋報告戰況，又向蒙古納貢，1258年與蒙古議定每三年進貢一次的常例。名義上的臣屬關係換來實質上的繼續自主，這份默契維持了二十多年，也為1284年、1287年兩次入侵埋下伏筆：忽必烈要求的親朝、質子與達魯花赤駐節，一直被陳朝拒絕，衝突因此升級。從武器史的角度看，這一役也留下了一次清楚的反證：以騎兵與衝鋒為核心的蒙古攻勢，在炎熱、潮濕、河道縱橫而城防密集的南方三角洲被弩、舟船與縱深抵抗拖住，北方騎兵在這裡缺少發揮的空間，而弩手在城頭與舟船上守住了防線。陳朝自此更倚重弩手，越南的弩術傳統在這次戰役之後也更見鞏固。
impactEn: The direct effects of this campaign reached well beyond the battlefield. The Mongols entered Thăng Long without capturing the Trần court, which meant that the policy of taking Đại Việt quickly had failed; the Mongols' strategic weight in the south stayed on the Song, and the Vietnamese theatre served only as a flank and a diversion. For the Trần dynasty the victory mattered far more than the loss of the city: once the news spread that Thái Tông had struck from his tower ships and recovered the capital amid the confusion, Lê Tâm was granted the title 輔陳, raised to Censor-in-Chief and married to the former empress, and the stockade chief Hà Bổng was ennobled as a lord; Vietnamese society came to treat the war as the founding battle of the dynasty, the image of Lê Tâm riding alone in and out of the enemy ranks was written into the official histories, and later Vietnamese historiography built on this the legend of a dynasty that thrice repelled the Mongols. The institutional consequences lasted longer still: having driven the Yuan back, the Trần court gave an accounting to both sides at once, reporting the campaign to the Southern Song while paying tribute to the Mongols, and in 1258 they agreed with the Mongols a fixed tribute of one delivery every three years. A nominal relationship of dependence bought real continued autonomy; that understanding held for more than twenty years and at the same time planted the seed of the invasions of 1284 and 1287, since the Mongol demands that the king should come to court in person, send hostages and accept a darughachi were always refused by the Trần, and the quarrel escalated. For the history of weapons the campaign also left a clear demonstration of the reverse: an offensive built on cavalry and the charge was held up in the hot, wet, river-cut southern delta by the crossbow, the boats and resistance in depth; the northern horse had little room to work there, and the crossbowmen held the line on the walls and in the boats. The Trần court henceforth relied more heavily on crossbowmen, and the Vietnamese tradition of the crossbow grew firmer after this war.
result: 結局是蒙古軍在攻佔國都之後被迫全軍退出交趾。兀良哈台的部隊在十二月初旬連下平厲原、破昇龍，卻只得到一座被搬空、焚毀的都城；元軍在城內停留九日，暑熱、缺糧與糧道太長三重壓力同時出現，退意已決；十二月二十四日，陳太宗與太子陳晃乘樓船在東步頭取得一捷，蒙古軍再退至歸化寨，又被寨主何俸集合的蠻兵與地方武裝襲擊，元軍最終撤回雲南。陳朝收復國都，陳太宗一度打算讓位於太子陳晃，並遣使告知南宋，國號、疆域與政權形式都沒有改變，陳守度與陳國峻的權位亦未變。雙方隨即轉入外交：1258年，陳朝遣黎輔陳、周博覽赴蒙古議定每三年進貢一次的常例，同時維持與南宋的往來，第一次蒙越戰爭以蒙古退兵、陳朝守土、互派使者的方式收場。對蒙古而言，這是一場得不償失的遠征：沒有拿到一個可以被挾持的國君，沒有取得常駐的權柄，反而把陳朝推成了對蒙古最堅硬的一個對手，此後元使每次要求陳朝親朝，等於替下一次出兵準備藉口。歷史上第一次蒙越之爭的實際結果，與二十多年後第二、第三次入侵的結果驚人地相似：元軍可以攻入都城，卻沒有一役能守住戰果，最後都靠天氣、疫情與糧草把人趕回北方；而越南這邊靠的也不是一時的勇敢，而是城防、弩陣、舟船與後方寨兵一環扣一環的牽制。
resultEn: In the end the Mongol army was forced to leave Đại Việt entirely after occupying the capital. Urryankhadai's corps took Bình Lệ Nguyên and broke into Thăng Long in the first days of the twelfth month, and won only a capital that had been emptied and burned; the Yuan stayed nine days inside it, with heat, hunger and an over-long line of supply pressing at once, and the decision to withdraw was already taken. On the twenty-fourth day of the twelfth month Thái Tông and the crown prince Trần Hoảng won a victory at Đông Bước from the tower ships, the Mongols were driven back to Quy Hóa, and there the stockade chief Hà Bổng and the local fighters fell on them again, until the army finally returned to Yunnan. The Trần recovered the capital; Thái Tông at one point thought of handing the throne to the crown prince Trần Hoảng and sent word of it to the Song, but the state title, the territory and the form of government were all unchanged, as were the positions of Trần Thủ Độ and Trần Quốc Tuấn. Diplomacy followed the fighting: in 1258 the Trần court sent Lê Phụ Trần and Chu Bác Lãm to the Mongols to agree the standing tribute of one delivery every three years, while keeping up relations with the Southern Song, and the first war between the Mongols and Đại Việt ended with the Yuan gone, the Trần holding their ground, and envoys exchanged in both directions. For the Mongols this was a costly expedition: no king was obtained who could be used as a hostage, no lasting authority was gained, and instead the Trần were hardened into the stiffest opponent the Mongols had in the region, so that every later summons that the king of Đại Việt should come to court was in effect a pretext for the next expedition. The actual outcome of the first Mongol war against Đại Việt is strikingly similar to the results of the second and third invasions more than twenty years later: the Yuan could enter the capital, yet no campaign held its gains, and in the end heat, disease and shortage of food drove the soldiers back north; and the Vietnamese side did not rest on a single burst of courage but on city walls, crossbow formations, boats and the stockade fighters behind them, each holding the next.
